summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting third-quarter 2026 operational results, not a special situation. The Brazilian aerospace manufacturer delivered 66 aircraft in 3Q26, up 2% quarter-over-quarter and 6% year-over-year, the strongest third quarter in its history, with 175 aircraft delivered in the first nine months of 2026, 14% above the prior-year period. Management reiterated full-year 2026 guidance of 80-85 commercial and 160-170 executive aircraft. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are implicated. Risk-arbitrage relevance is absent; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer operational update.
